messages.subject: Retour des Gant's
messages.text:
We have been in touch re my gloves. 
 I have now tried them twice as you suggested
 But not really satisfied
 My son in law who they were for takes his children for a walk in the stroller each day in suburban area. 
 His fingers were warm but the wrists cold . Pulling the elastic tight made no difference as it was too tight on wrists. And the uninsulated wrist area is cold. It needs an internal cuff. 
 And the lLasclay clip which I thought was to facilitate keeping them together when not in use broke instantly. 
 So not satisfied at all. 
 

 Will you still accept a return.?
 

 I hate to say but the Nate's gloves at 30$ were liked the best And now used all the time. 
 

 Love the idea of using milkweed but this design needs an upgrade. 
 
 I await your response
 Judi Roe

messages.subject: Re: Retour des Gant's
messages.text:
Hi Judi,

You've now tried them twice and given us very specific feedback, cold wrists, the clip breaking. That's fair, and yes, we'll absolutely accept the return.

The wrist coverage is a real design gap you've pointed out, and the clip breaking right away isn't normal at all, that's a defect. Because of that, we'll cover the return in full, no handling fee. Your feedback goes straight to our product team, it's exactly the kind of detail that helps us improve the next version.

Here's how the return works:

1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/, enter your order number and postal code, select the mittens, and choose refund. You'll get a prepaid return label.
2. Print the label, pack the mittens in an envelope or bag (not a box), and drop it at the nearest Canada Post location.
3. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund.

If you run into any trouble with the portal, let us know and we'll sort it out another way.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
